profile.org_note: Family-owned and run by the three founding brothers (Kimball, Josh and Chris Hakes); Kimball Hakes is the CEO. Third-party directories show a small corporate bench under him (CFO Andrew Vieth, COO Paul Carey, a general counsel) and division presidents by market. No land executive is named anywhere public, so land decisions most likely sit with the brothers, the division presidents and the CFO. The company publishes no leadership page; the legal name 'Hakes Brothers, LLC' is taken from the Better Business Bureau listing title seen in search results and operating entities such as 'Hakes Brothers LCNM, LLC', 'Hakes Brothers ABQ, LLC' and 'Hakes Brothers SATX LLC' appear in job postings and public records, none confirmed against a state registry. The Albuquerque leader shown is from a February 2024 newspaper report.
profile.summary: Private, family-owned, conventional for-sale homebuilder founded in Las Cruces in 2006 and self-described as the largest homebuilder based in New Mexico, with more than 7,000 homes sold. It lists 57 communities across seven markets in New Mexico, Texas and the Kansas City area, selling entry-level and move-up detached homes; newer markets are Kansas City (2023), the Rio Grande Valley and the Austin area (San Marcos). Builder's firm page shows 841 closings and $308M revenue for 2024 (rank 75 on the 2025 list); the 2026 rank is in the spine. The orchestrator's lead of Arizona and Colorado operations is not supported by the company site.

gaps: Head of land acquisition / land development: not publicly disclosed. No land executive is named on the company site, in press, or in the directories opened. A recruiter posting for a 'Director of Land Acquisition' in Las Cruces for 'the region's largest homebuilder' appeared in search results (careers-page.com/sound-decisions), but the page returned 404 and the employer is not named, so it is only a hint that the role exists or was being filled.
President (separate from the CEO): none named publicly; directories call Kimball Hakes 'President' and Builder calls him CEO.
Treasurer / controller / VP finance below the CFO: not publicly disclosed.
Kansas City division president: not publicly disclosed (a job posting seen in search results refers to a Kansas City 'Division President' without a name).
Rio Grande Valley and Austin-area leadership: not publicly disclosed; appears to sit under the Texas division.
Current Rio Grande division president (Las Cruces / El Paso): not confirmed; Dan Nielsen held it in 2021-2022.
Reporting lines below the CEO: not published; the three shown are inferred from titles.
Email pattern and direct phones: none published; only office numbers (corporate 575-373-8300, Rio Grande division 575-373-1120, Albuquerque division 505-842-1700).
Legal entity name and ownership split among the brothers: not confirmed against a state registry.
Arizona and Colorado operations (orchestrator lead): not found; the company site lists only New Mexico, Texas and Kansas City (KS/MO).

Most executive rows rest on undated third-party directories (The Org, Neuron) because the company has no leadership page and the swarm's shared web-search allowance ran out before local-press searches for each market could be run. builderonline.com blocks direct fetches (archived copies were used); connectcre.com, bbb.org, jobtarget.com and newhomesource.com pages would not load.
